scope: Selected production activity-arrest creation and charge snapshot guard at 95e; source identity, all aliases and other independent lenses remain open.
source_reasoning: Pinned source inspection and historical evidence-byte verification only. No product build, test, runtime, database or browser probe.

nonfinding.question: Can the selected normal arrest creation path call snapshot again for a party that already has a pending arrest and append a later offense to that same pending incident?
nonfinding.disposition: The snapshot helper alone inserts a charge for each currently unsettled offense whose incident/offense key is absent, so a repeated direct call with a changed list would append it. In the selected production path, create_strategic_incident first returns None if the party has any Pending incident. The caller invokes snapshot_arrest_charges only after creation returns Some for an AuthorityArrest. Therefore a repeat through this path while that party's arrest is pending does not call the snapshot helper again. This is a bounded source safeguard, not a proof that all caller, replay, collision or concurrent states are safe.
nonfinding.other_qualified_cases: The arrest source identity hashes the ordered unsettled offense IDs and retains only 16 hexadecimal digits; different lists can theoretically collide and source identity includes no offense payload. If a nonpending existing incident is returned for the same source, the snapshot can run again. Actual admitted collision, other callers or conflicting payloads were not established. Surrender uses the recorded incident/character/settlement charges and pays then settles them; a separate guarded source fixture was read but not run.
